items.description: Renders an image with OpenAI gpt-image-1 and saves it to Artifacts.

items.description: Reads a competitor's site with Firecrawl and writes a one-page positioning brief.

items.description: An agent fixes the bug; a check runs your test command and sends it back until the tests pass.
